## `neuro.uint16Array.includes`

Instance method on `Uint16Array.prototype`.

> Determines whether an array includes a certain element, returning true or false as appropriate.

## Signatures

```ts
includes(input: { uint16Array: <receiver>; searchElement: number; fromIndex?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint16Array.prototype.includes` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
